title: MZ How do you make enemies not move when using ranged attacks.

posts.author: Darkmoon9
posts.body: Hi, in RPG Maker MZ, one of the new fearures is the move forward to attack an actor, even using attacks that should be ranged. How do you get them to stay where they are when using ranged attacks/ranged skillls but not for melee attacks?

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Isn't that a plugin doing that? And you can use VS action sequences to make it act how you want.

posts.author: Darkmoon9
posts.body:
rpgLord69 said:
Isn't that a plugin doing that? And you can use VS action sequences to make it act how you want.
Click to expand...
Truth be told I have no idea, it might be the Visustella Battle Core plugin. As for action sequences, is it actseqcamera, actseqimpact or actseqprojectiles that I need to accomplish what I seek?
I have no clue how action sequences work to be honest.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
What? No you can just use Battle Core to make the action sequences. You can make the ranged weapons have a trait that gives an attack skill where you put a custom action sequence where you don't move to the opponent.
EDIT: And make actions sequences for your skills too.

Will look into it. Things already works as it should for actors. It is just that because enemies doesn't use actual weapons, it doesn't register when an attack should use a ranged weapon or not. Putting the right notetag on the skills they use might fix it.
